cues: For a product of two different kinds of function, use integration by parts: the product rule backwards.

The integral of u d v is u v minus the integral of v d u. Choose u as the factor that gets simpler when differentiated; the rule ILATE gives the order: inverse trig, log, algebraic, trig, exponential.
